in_sanskrit.name: एकाशा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ekam Asi, meaning 'I am One', is a famous mantra in Hinduism. Ekasha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ekam' which means 'One'. The suffix '-asha' denotes the state or condition of being. So, Ekasha means 'The state or condition of being One' or 'The state of being Alone' or 'The Solitary State'.

in_hindi.name: एकाशा
in_hindi.long_meaning: Ek meaning 'One' and Asha meaning 'hope' or 'wish'. So, Ekasha can be interpreted as 'The One who gives Hope' or 'The One who fulfills Wishes'. It can also mean 'The Solitary One'.

in_tamil.name: ஐகாஷா
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, Ekasha is derived from the Tamil words 'ஐ' (One) and 'அஷா' (asha), which mean 'hope' or 'wish'. So, Ekasha can be interpreted as 'The One who gives Hope' or 'The One who fulfills Wishes' in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: ేకాశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: Ekasha is derived from the Telugu words 'ేక (Eka)' meaning 'One' and 'శ (asha)' meaning 'state' or 'condition'. So, Ekasha can be interpreted as 'The State or Condition of Being One' or 'The Solitary State' in Telugu.

in_marathi.name: Ekasha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ekasha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ekasha is a Sanskrit word that means unique or one. It is derived from the root word 'eka' which means one. This name is often given to a child who is believed to be unique or special in some way.
